# Review — PAN-4723
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — PR #4725 description does not name the unmocked call or the intermittency reason (issue AC 1 / FR-5 / AC-7)

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4723-review-7ac25ddb
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4723/.pan/review/agent-pan-4723-review-7ac25ddb/context.json

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] PR description omits the root-cause explanation the issue requires — PR #4725 body
- Severity: !
- Classification / requirement scope: requirements gap (implementation incomplete); in_pr_scope
- Trigger and changed-code connection: Issue #4723's first acceptance criterion reads "The PR names the unmocked call and the reason it was intermittent." The PRD carries it as FR-5 and AC-7, and the xBRIEF item `mock-disk-floor-create-workspace-row` traces FR-5 with an acceptance item requiring the PR description to name `checkDiskFloor`'s `statfs` read at `src/lib/workspace-manager/create.ts:202`, runner free disk near 10 GiB as the cause, and the `git branch --show-current` log line as coming from `continue-readers-plan-home.test.ts`.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected a PR body with that explanation. Observed (`gh pr view 4725 --json body`) only an issue link and three checked boxes ("Mock checkDiskFloor in …"). The issue's hypothesis (an unmocked git call) is wrong, and a reader of the merged PR would not learn that, so the explicit in-scope AC fails.
- Evidence: `gh pr view feature/pan-4723 --json body,title` at HEAD 7ac25ddb (title is just "PAN-4723"). The full explanation already exists in the body of commit 9c76da9b7f4, but the issue AC and the xBRIEF acceptance item name the PR description, and a squash merge would not surface it there. The xBRIEF also marks this AC sub-item closed (commit f865fb356cb), which does not match the PR body.
- Fix: Copy the explanation from commit 9c76da9b7f4's body into the PR #4725 description. It must state: (1) the unmocked call is `checkDiskFloor(projectConfig.path)` at `src/lib/workspace-manager/create.ts:202`, which reads real free space with `statfs` from `node:fs/promises`, not covered by the `util.promisify` exec mock; (2) it was intermittent because GitHub runner free disk on `/tmp` hovers near the 10 GiB floor (run 41317624589 attempt 1 had 9.3 GiB, 9/10 tests failed with "Only 9.3 GiB free…"); (3) the `Error capturing git state … git branch --show-current` line is `handoff-context.ts:166` logging during the unrelated, passing `continue-readers-plan-home.test.ts`. Optionally quote the low-disk repro counts below. No code change is needed.

## Non-blocking Findings
None. The code change itself is correct and complete.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger
| File | Status |
| --- | --- |
| tests/unit/lib/workspace-manager/create-workspace-row.test.ts | Reviewed. Hoisted `mockCheckDiskFloor`, module mock with `importOriginal` (keeps `DISK_SAFETY_FLOOR_BYTES`, `readAvailableBytes`), reset + `null` default in `beforeEach`, `toHaveBeenCalledWith(tempDir)` assertion, new refusal test. Matches PRD WI-1. |
| tests/unit/lib/workspace-manager/create-resume-setup.test.ts | Reviewed. Same mock shape; reset in top-level `beforeEach`. Matches WI-2. |
| tests/lib/workspace-manager.test.ts | Reviewed. Same mock with `../../src/lib/disk-floor.js`; reset in `createWorkspace` describe `beforeEach`. `vi.mock` survives `vi.resetModules()`, confirmed by the low-disk run passing. Matches WI-3. |
| .overdeck/context/codebase/conventions.md | Reviewed. Accurate one-entry testing note; satisfies WI-4 docs justification. |
| .pan/drafts/PAN-4723.md, PAN-4723-critique.md, PAN-4723-critique-2.md | Reviewed as planning artifacts; root-cause analysis verified against source (below). |
| .pan/specs/…PAN-4723….xbrief.json, .pan/continues/PAN-4723.xbrief.json | Reviewed as plan artifacts; no runtime effect. |

### Root-cause verification
`src/lib/disk-floor.ts` `checkDiskFloor` uses a default reader bound to `statfs`; its only production caller is `src/lib/workspace-manager/create.ts:34/202`, which runs before the workspace row and before any exec call. Mocking the module (not `readAvailableBytes`) is the correct seam, since the default parameter binds the local function.

### Dimensions
- Correctness: mocks reset per test; the refusal test's `mockExecAsync).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` holds because nothing before line 202 execs. The mocked message string contains the word "retry"; it is not a retry config, and `src/lib/cloister/test-skip-gate.ts` (SKIP_OR_ONLY, CONDITIONAL_SKIP, lines 49-50) has no `retry` pattern, so the gate will not trip on it.
- Security: test-only change; no trust boundary touched. N/A.
- Performance: test-only; removes a real `statfs` per call. N/A.
- Requirements/UX: see AC matrix. No `src/` change (NFR-2), no skip/skipIf/.only/retry/timeout added (NFR-1).

| Issue AC2 / AC-3 — 50 consecutive passes | Met | The work agent claims 50/50 (AC sub-items closed in f865fb356cb). The reviewer ran 10/10. The decisive evidence is that the only nondeterminism source (real `statfs`) is removed, confirmed by the low-disk repro. |
| Issue AC3 / NFR-1 — no skip/skipIf/retry | Met | `git diff main...HEAD -- tests` grep. |

| AC-4 — resume-setup passes and mocks disk-floor | Met | vitest run. |

| AC-6 / NFR-2 — only three test files outside .pan/.overdeck; no src change | Met | `git diff main...HEAD --stat -- . ':!.pan' ':!.overdeck'` lists exactly the three test files. |
| FR-1..FR-3 — pass on <10 GiB filesystem | Met | Low-disk repro below. |

## Verification
- `npx vitest run` on the three touched files (default TMPDIR): 3 files, 25 tests passed.
- Low-disk repro, `TMPDIR` on a 6.3 GiB tmpfs (`/run/user/1000/pan4723-review`, removed afterwards): branch versions 25/25 passed; the `main` version of `create-workspace-row.test.ts` under the same TMPDIR failed 9 of 10, matching the CI signature. This confirms both the diagnosis and the fix. (The baseline probe was a temporary copy written beside the test file and deleted immediately; worktree is unchanged apart from the pre-existing `.pan/continues` modification.)
- 10-run loop of `create-workspace-row.test.ts`: 10/10 passed.
- CI on HEAD 7ac25ddb: `overdeck/test` verification gate passed (typecheck + lint); test shards 1–4, build, lint-groups (core/effect/state), e2e were **pending** at review time, so CI tests are unverified.
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: not applicable — test-only change, no TypeScript source, Effect dependency, or compiler config touched.

## Scope Note
The single blocker is a PR-description edit; no code change is required. Once the description carries the root-cause explanation, this should approve on the next cycle.
